source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("street vendors" OR "informal traders" OR "informal workers") AND (digital OR app OR platform OR "digital payment")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("street vendors" OR "informal traders" OR "informal workers") AND (digital OR app OR platform OR "digital payment"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("digital payment" OR "app" OR "digital" OR "platform") AND ("informal traders" OR "informal workers" OR "street vendors"))
